name: Miralcamp (Spain)
description: Yellow field with three black zigzag (dancetty) horizontal stripes, charged at the centre with a white sword point downward.
history: The official flag of Miralcamp is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, yellow, with three black viperate (dancetty) stripes perpendicular to the hoist and with nine complete angles; the distance between the stripes, and between them and the upper and lower edges, is always constant.

features.role: three dancetty (viperate) stripes with nine complete angles
sword with a wavy blade, point downward, at the centre
